 {id:'m-brand-intro',cat:'motion',icon:'✦',title:'Brand Motion Intro',desc:'Mở đầu nhận diện thương hiệu 5–8 giây.',task:'video',target:'motion',ratio:'16:9',text:'Create a premium brand motion intro.   if(!sample||card.querySelector('.cv190-poster-info'))return;
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='cv190-poster-info';box.innerHTML='<div class="cv190-poster-person"><b>'+esc(sample.person)+' · '+sample.age+' tuổi</b><small>'+esc(sample.role)+' · '+esc(sample.company)+'</small></div><p>'+esc(sample.metric)+'</p><div class="cv190-poster-actions" data-cv190-poster-action><select aria-label="Loại đầu ra" class="input" data-cv190-poster-mode><option value="motion">Motion</option><option value="site">Site / Website</option><option value="ai">AI Creative</option></select><button type="button" class="btn btn-primary sm" data-cv190-poster-prompt="'+esc(id)+'">Tạo Motion/Site/AI từ mẫu này</button></div><small class="cv190-demo-note">'+esc(sample.industry)+' · Dữ liệu & hình minh hoạ demo dựng tại máy</small>';
  card.appendChild(box);
 });
}
function renderCustomTemplates(){

 if(kind==='all'||kind==='motion')html+=MOTION_TEMPLATES.filter(t=>!q||norm(t.name+' '+t.desc+' '+(t.brief||'')).includes(q)).map(motionCard).join('');
 if(kind==='all'||kind==='prompt')html+=PROMPTS.filter(p=>!q||norm(p.title+' '+p.desc+' '+p.cat+' '+(p.sampleRefs||[]).join(' ')).includes(q)).map(promptCard).join('');
 if(html)grid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
 const count=$('#tplCount');if(count){const prior=(count.textContent||'').split(' · ')[0];const custom=kind==='all'?MOTION_TEMPLATES.length+PROMPTS.length:kind==='motion'?MOTION_TEMPLATES.length:kind==='prompt'?PROMPTS.length:0;if(custom)count.textContent=(parseInt(prior,10)||0)+' + '+custom+' nội dung bổ sung';}
}

function applyMotionTemplate(id){const t=MOTION_TEMPLATES.find(x=>x.id===id),engine=window.CVNativeEngines&&CVNativeEngines.motionLab;if(!t||!engine||!engine.snapshotState||!engine.restoreState){toast('Motion Lab chưa sẵn sàng');return}try{const old=JSON.parse(engine.snapshotState()||'{"objs":[],"duration":5}');const ratio=$('#mlRatio');if(ratio)ratio.value=t.ratio;const r=t.ratio.split(':').map(Number),w=r[0]>=r[1]?960:Math.round(960*r[0]/r[1]),h=r[0]>=r[1]?Math.round(960*r[1]/r[0]):960;const incoming=t.layers.map((l,i)=>({id:'cv190_'+t.id+'_'+Date.now().toString(36)+'_'+i,type:l.type,text:l.text||'',color:l.color||'#FFFFFF',fontFamily:'Be Vietnam Pro',weight:l.weight||800,size:l.size||58,motion:l.motion||'fade',delay:l.delay||0,duration:l.duration||t.duration,ease:l.ease||'smooth',x:Math.round(w*(l.x==null?.5:l.x)),y:Math.round(h*(l.y==null?.5:l.y))}));engine.restoreState({objs:(old.objs||[]).concat(incoming),duration:Math.max(old.duration||0,t.duration)});engine.action('save');const status=$('#mlStatus');if(status)status.textContent=(old.objs||[]).length+incoming.length+' đối tượng';CV.go('motionLab');toast('Đã thêm preset “'+t.name+'” vào Motion Lab. Các layer hiện có được giữ nguyên.')}catch(e){toast('Không áp dụng được motion preset: '+e.message)}}
function choosePrompt(id,options){const p=PROMPTS.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;selectedPrompt=p;options=options||{};const brief=$('#cv190PromptBrief'),extra=$('#cv190PromptExtra'),preview=$('#cv190PromptSelected');const current=$('#pfBrief');const b=options.brief||((brief&&brief.value.trim())||(current&&current.value.trim())||'Mô tả sản phẩm, dự án, đối tượng và thông điệp chính.');const add=extra&&extra.value.trim();const context=window.CVCreativeCore&&CVCreativeCore.context?CVCreativeCore.context():{};const brand=(()=>{const q=['bPrimary','bSecondary','bAccent'].map(id=>$('#'+id)).filter(Boolean).map(x=>x.value);return q.length?q.join(', '):''})();let sections=[];
 sections.push('ROLE & OBJECTIVE\nAct as a senior creative director and production designer. '+p.text);
 sections.push('PROJECT BRIEF\n'+b);
 if(p.cat==='motion')sections.push('MOTION SPECIFICATION\nFormat: '+p.ratio+'. Duration: define a precise timeline appropriate to the brief. Provide timecodes, shot size, camera movement, action, transition, easing, typography timing, safe areas and a final hold. Preserve continuity between shots.');
 if(p.cat==='site')sections.push('SITE / UX SPECIFICATION\nResponsive desktop, tablet and mobile. Define sitemap, section hierarchy, reusable components, navigation, responsive behavior, accessibility, SEO, performance, and empty/loading/error/success states. Include production-ready content structure and interaction notes.');
 if(p.cat==='ai')sections.push('AI GENERATION SPECIFICATION\nDefine subject, art direction, composition, camera/lens where relevant, lighting, material/detail, palette, background and aspect ratio. Preserve reference identity/product geometry when applicable. Do not fabricate logos or long text.');
 if(brand)sections.push('BRAND TOKENS\nUse the current CANVIO brand palette where suitable: '+brand+'. Keep contrast and readability accessible.');
 if(context.projectName)sections.push('PROJECT CONTEXT\n'+context.projectName);
 if(add)sections.push('ADDITIONAL / NEGATIVE REQUIREMENTS\n'+add);
 sections.push('DELIVERABLE & QUALITY CHECK\nReturn a clearly structured, production-ready result. State assumptions, preserve factual accuracy, check consistency, legibility, responsive behavior or motion continuity as relevant, and list any missing inputs instead of inventing them.');
 const out=sections.join('\n\n');const pfbrief=$('#pfBrief'),pfTask=$('#pfTask'),pfRatio=$('#pfRatio'),pfOutput=$('#pfOutput');if(pfbrief)pfbrief.value=b;if(pfTask)pfTask.value=p.task;if(pfRatio)pfRatio.value=p.ratio==='responsive'?'16:9':p.ratio;if(pfOutput)pfOutput.value=out;if(preview)preview.textContent=p.title+' · '+(p.cat==='motion'?'Motion / Video':p.cat==='site'?'Website / UI':'AI Creative')+' · Prompt đã nạp vào Prompt Forge.';
 const qa=$('#pfQA');if(qa)qa.innerHTML='<div class="ne-check ok"><i>✓</i>Brief và mục tiêu</div><div class="ne-check ok"><i>✓</i>Chỉ dẫn theo nhóm '+(p.cat==='motion'?'motion':p.cat==='site'?'website':'AI')+'</div><div class="ne-check ok"><i>✓</i>Đầu ra và quality gate</div><small class="ne-help">Prompt được dựng cục bộ; chưa gọi AI hoặc tiêu hao API.</small>';
 CV.go('promptForge');toast('Đã nạp prompt “'+p.title+'”. Chỉnh brief rồi copy hoặc chuyển đến engine.');}

Bạn kiểm tra lại brief và chọn thời điểm gọi AI.</p><div class="stack" style="gap:7px"><button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" data-cv190-prompt-send="motion">🎬 Gửi Video ShotCraft / Video Studio</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" data-cv190-prompt-send="site">◫ Gửi AI Studio để xây Site</button><button type="button" class="btn btn-soft" data-cv190-prompt-send="ai">✦ Gửi Image Studio / AI Studio</button></div><p class="cv190-prompt-note" style="margin-top:10px">Prompt Website có thể dùng làm đặc tả cho Web Engine; Web Engine không tự biến prompt thành website nếu chưa có model/API tạo mã.</p></div></div><div class="cv190-prompt-grid" id="cv190PromptGrid" style="margin-top:12px"></div>';

 box.addEventListener('click',e=>{const tab=e.target.closest('[data-cv190-pcat]');if(tab){promptKind=tab.dataset.cv190Pcat;box.querySelectorAll('[data-cv190-pcat]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===tab));renderPromptCards();return}const card=e.target.closest('[data-cv190-select]');if(card){choosePrompt(card.dataset.cv190Select);return}const act=e.target.closest('[data-cv190-prompt-build],[data-cv190-prompt-copy],[data-cv190-prompt-save],[data-cv190-prompt-send]');if(!act)return;const output=$('#pfOutput');const text=output&&output.value;if(act.hasAttribute('data-cv190-prompt-build')){if(!selectedPrompt){toast('Chọn một prompt trước');return}choosePrompt(selectedPrompt.id);return}if(act.hasAttribute('data-cv190-prompt-copy')){if(!text)return toast('Chọn prompt trước');CV.util.copy(text);toast('Đã copy prompt');return}if(act.hasAttribute('data-cv190-prompt-save')){if(!text)return toast('Chọn prompt trước');if(typeof addAsset==='function')addAsset(new Blob([text],{type:'text/plain'}),'CANVIO_Prompt_'+(selectedPrompt?selectedPrompt.id:'custom')+'.txt').then(()=>toast('Đã lưu prompt vào Asset Library')).catch(err=>toast(err.message));else toast('Không tìm thấy bộ lưu Asset Library');return}if(act.hasAttribute('data-cv190-prompt-send')){sendPrompt(act.dataset.cv190PromptSend)}});
 const search=$('#cv190PromptSearch');if(search)search.addEventListener('input',renderPromptCards);
}
function renderPromptCards(){const grid=$('#cv190PromptGrid');if(!grid)return;const q=norm(($('#cv190PromptSearch')||{}).value||'');const list=PROMPTS.filter(p=>p.cat===promptKind&&(!q||norm(p.title+' '+p.desc+' '+p.text).includes(q)));$('#cv190PromptCount').textContent=list.length+' prompt';grid.innerHTML=list.map(p=>'<article class="cv190-prompt-card"><div class="pc-icon">'+esc(p.icon)+'</div><b>'+esc(p.title)+'</b><p>'+esc(p.desc)+'</p><button type="button" class="btn btn-soft sm" data-cv190-select="'+p.id+'">Nạp prompt</button></article>').join('')||'<div class="cv190-empty">Không tìm thấy prompt phù hợp.</div>'}
function sendPrompt(kind){const text=($('#pfOutput')||{}).value||'';if(!text.trim())return toast('Hãy chọn hoặc xây prompt trước');let page='studio',field='studioPrompt',label='AI Studio';if(kind==='motion'){page='videoStudio';field='vidScript';label='Video Studio';}if(kind==='ai'){page='imageStudio';field='imgPrompt';label='Image Studio';}CV.go(page);setTimeout(()=>{let el=$('#'+field);if(!el&&kind==='motion'){CV.go('shotcraft');el=$('#sc-projConcept')}if(el){el.value=text;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));toast('Đã chuyển prompt sang '+label+'; kiểm tra trước khi sử dụng.')}else{CV.util.copy(text);toast('Đã copy prompt. Công cụ đích chưa có ô nhận prompt tự động.')}},260)}
function openPosterPrompt(tplId,mode){
 const index=Number(String(tplId||'').replace('tpl','')),item=CV.templates&&CV.templates.build?CV.templates.build()[index]:null,sample=item&&item.sample;if(!sample)return toast('Không tìm thấy dữ liệu mẫu Poster');
 const cat=mode||'motion';const promptId=cat==='site'?(sample.industry.indexOf('Nhân sự')>=0?'s-recruit':sample.industry.indexOf('Tài chính')>=0?'s-dashboard':sample.industry.indexOf('Bán lẻ')>=0?'s-commerce':sample.industry.indexOf('Sự kiện')>=0?'s-event':sample.industry.indexOf('F&B')>=0?'s-editorial':'s-saas'):cat==='ai'?(sample.visual==='portrait'||sample.visual==='clinic'?'a-portrait':sample.visual==='earbuds'?'a-product':sample.visual==='building'?'a-background':'a-keyvisual'):(sample.visual==='app'?'m-app-demo':sample.visual==='earbuds'?'m-product-reveal':sample.visual==='retail'?'m-social-reel':sample.visual==='finance'||sample.visual==='analytics'?'m-explainer':'m-brand-intro');
 promptKind=cat;const brief=posterBrief(sample),extra='Nguồn là nội dung demo của thư viện CANVIO. Dùng đúng tên riêng, tuổi, chức danh, ngày tháng, giá và số liệu đã cung cấp. Hình minh hoạ cần bám sát ngành: '+sample.visual+'. Không dùng quả cầu gradient, không dùng logo giả, không thêm tuyên bố chưa được cung cấp.';
 const b=$('#cv190PromptBrief'),x=$('#cv190PromptExtra');if(b)b.value=brief;if(x)x.value=extra;
 const suite=$('#cv190-prompt-suite');if(suite)suite.querySelectorAll('[data-cv190-pcat]').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('active',el.dataset.cv190Pcat===cat));
 renderPromptCards();choosePrompt(promptId,{brief:brief});
}
function onTemplateClick(e){
 const poster=e.target.closest('[data-cv190-poster-prompt]');if(poster){const card=poster.closest('.tplCard'),mode=card&&card.querySelector('[data-cv190-poster-mode]');openPosterPrompt(poster.dataset.cv190PosterPrompt,mode?mode.value:'motion');return}
 const m=e.target.closest('[data-cv190-use-motion]');if(m){applyMotionTemplate(m.dataset.cv190UseMotion);return}
 const p=e.target.closest('[data-cv190-use-prompt]');if(p){const item=PROMPTS.find(x=>x.id===p.dataset.cv190UsePrompt);if(item){promptKind=item.cat;renderPromptCards();choosePrompt(item.id)}return}
}
function init(){installTemplateIntro();installTemplateTabs();installPromptSuite();const grid=$('#tplGrid');if(grid&&!grid.__cv190Bound){grid.__cv190Bound=true;grid.addEventListener('click',onTemplateClick)}if(window.CV&&CV.templates&&CV.templates.render&&!CV.templates.render.__cv190){const old=CV.templates.render;const wrapped=function(){const r=old.apply(this,arguments);try{renderCustomTemplates()}catch(e){}return r};wrapped.__cv190=true;CV.templates.render=wrapped;CV.templates.render()}document.title='CANVIO 19.0 — Template & Prompt Library';if(window.CANVIO_RELEASE){CANVIO_RELEASE.version='19.0.0';CANVIO_RELEASE.edition='Template & Prompt Library';CANVIO_RELEASE.upgrade='Data-rich Poster samples, local SVG art, unified library filter state and Poster-to-Prompt Forge workflow for Motion / Site / AI.';CANVIO_RELEASE.features=(CANVIO_RELEASE.features||[]).concat(['Unified Template Library v2','Data-rich Poster samples','Local SVG visual previews','Unified Poster/Motion/Prompt filter state','Poster-to-Prompt Forge handoff','Motion / Site / AI Prompt Packs'])}}
window.CV190Library={version:'19.0.0',templates:MOTION_TEMPLATES,prompts:PROMPTS,posterSamples:window.CV190PosterSamples||{},applyMotion:applyMotionTemplate,selectPrompt:choosePrompt,render:renderCustomTemplates,openPosterPrompt:openPosterPrompt,tests:function(){const built=CV.templates&&CV.templates.build?CV.templates.build():[];const samples=built.filter(x=>x.sample);return {templatePage:!!$('#page-templates'),promptPage:!!$('#page-promptForge'),posterTemplates:built.length,posterSampleCoverage:samples.length,allPosterCardsEnriched:samples.length===built.length,websiteTemplates:!!(window.CVLot56&&CVLot56.WEB&&CVLot56.WEB.length),portfolioTemplates:!!(window.CVLot56&&CVLot56.CVS&&CVLot56.CVS.length),motionTemplates:MOTION_TEMPLATES.length,promptPacks:PROMPTS.length,posterPromptLinks:typeof openPosterPrompt==='function',unifiedTemplateKind:!!window.CV190TemplateState,libraryTabs:!!$('#lib-k [data-k="motion"]')&&!!$('#lib-k [data-k="prompt"]'),promptUI:!!$('#cv190-prompt-suite'),localSvgPreviews:built.every(x=>!x.sample||x.doc.layers.some(l=>l.type==='image'&&/^data:image\/svg\+xml/.test(l.src||''))),noOrbPreview:!$('#tplGrid .cv190-template-card .cv190-orb')}}};
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>
